# Flood-Net

> Flood-Net (https://floodwarning.net) is the engineering register of the Bureau of Meteorology's Queensland flood-warning telemetry network — rainfall and river-height stations, repeaters, base stations and radio paths. Agents can read its public station data through a read-only REST API at https://floodwarning.net/api/v1 and an MCP server at https://floodwarning.net/api/mcp. It is not a flood warning service.

No sign-in or key. Rate limits: 60 requests / 60 s per client, 20 requests / 10 s per client (burst), 240 requests / 60 s per address; on 429 wait for Retry-After. Name your client with the X-FloodNet-Client header or ?client=. Station ids are lowercase slugs such as abergowrie_br_al (a Bureau station number also works); the dossier endpoint (/api/v1/stations/{id}/dossier, MCP tool get_station_dossier) returns everything about one station with sources. Flood classes are metres on the gauge, AEP levels modelled metres AHD (indicative). Full documentation: docs/agent-api.md.

## API

- [API index](https://floodwarning.net/api/v1/): version, endpoints, limits and links, as JSON
- [OpenAPI 3.1 document](https://floodwarning.net/api/v1/openapi.json): every endpoint, for function-calling agents and ChatGPT Actions
- [MCP server](https://floodwarning.net/api/mcp): Streamable HTTP (POST JSON-RPC), stateless, read-only; tools search_stations, stations_near, get_station, get_station_dossier, get_readings, get_flood_levels, get_service_level, list_catchments, get_catchment, list_networks

## Docs

- [docs/agent-api.md](https://github.com/cdomotor-g/MegaNet/blob/main/docs/agent-api.md): the agent API — setup for Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI, Codex and ChatGPT; every endpoint; limits; data provenance and caveats
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/cdomotor-g/MegaNet/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for agents reading the data or working in the repository
